news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.57 (vs ₹3.76 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.57 (down from ₹3.76 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹41.8b (up 12% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹6.93b (down 4.6% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 17% (down from 19% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 22% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 1.6% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 30% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 27% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 20 billion in funding
news.body: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Limited announced a private placement of by way of an issue of fully paid-up Equity Shares of the company to raise gross proceeds of INR 20,000,000,000. The transaction has been approved at the Board of Directors of the company and is subject to the receipt of necessary approvals including the approval of the shareholders of the Bank and such other regulatory and statutory approvals as may be required. The transaction will undergo in one or more tranches and/or one or more issuances simultaneously or otherwise.

news.title: UJJIVANSFB: Fundraising Plans And Improved Assumptions Will Shape Future Performance
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target for Ujjivan Small Finance Bank from about ₹41 to roughly ₹62, citing updated assumptions for fair value, discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E as key drivers behind the change. What's in the News The bank has scheduled a board meeting on May 8, 2026, to review and approve its audited financial results for the year ended March 31, 2026 (Key Developments).

news.title: Now 21% overvalued
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 3.9% to ₹61.37. The fair value is estimated to be ₹50.67, however this is not to be taken as a sell recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has grown by 4.3% over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has declined by 26%. Revenue is forecast to grow by 77% in 2 years. Earnings are forecast to grow by 151% in the next 2 years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.96 (vs ₹0.56 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.96 (up from ₹0.56 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹11.0b (up 32% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.86b (up 71% from 3Q 2025).
